title: Weight and Size Charges on Checked Bags: Ledger Posting Reference
content:
**Call center ledger reference — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** This entry governs the weight-or-size charge owed for the heaviest bag carrying a first, second or third bag charge on a ticket's first unflown segment when that bag carries no weight or size entry.

## When the charge is owed

- The charge is owed as soon as the records show the bag checked, whether or not the customer raises it.
- It is posted through the call center as one entry for that bag tag, of the component that is higher.
- A charge worked out at zero is not recorded, and a bag whose charge works out at zero owes no weight or size charge.

| Heaviest bag charged by count on the first unflown segment (hypothetical) | Weight-or-size charge owed |
|---|---|
| No weight or size entry; charge works out above zero | Yes, one entry of the higher component for its tag |
| Already carries a weight or size entry | Nothing further |
| No weight or size entry; charge works out at zero | Nothing owed; nothing recorded |

## The posting tool

`post_bag_weight_charge_02a99017` is an agent-side tool; the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one weight-or-size charge entry on the ticket's service-fee ledger for the tagged bag, of the component named, carrying the bag's travel direction, flight segment, weight and size as already recorded for that tag, at the amount given, paid through the call center. The ticket's net fee charges rise by that amount and the charge shows on the ticket's service fees at once. One call books exactly one component for one bag.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the ticket record the bag travels on, as returned by the ticket lookup | Identifier |
| `bag_tag_number` | The bag tag of the bag being charged, copied from the ticket's service-fee entries for that bag | CR followed by 6 digits |
| `corporate_account_id` | Reference number of the corporate travel agreement the ticket names, copied from the ticket record's corporate agreement field; an empty string when the ticket names no agreement | Identifier or empty string |
| `charge_component` | The component booked | Exactly one of `overweight_bag` (the charge recorded is the bag's weight charge: the weight charge is the higher of the two, or the bag is within the size limit) or `oversize_bag` (the charge recorded is the bag's size charge: the size charge is the higher of the two) |
| `charge_amount` | The weight-or-size charge | US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to the cent (2 decimal places) before it is passed |

### Return

A receipt with `service_id` (reference number of the new charge), `ticket_id`, `bag_tag_number`, `service_type` (`overweight_bag` or `oversize_bag`), `amount` (US dollars to 2 decimal places, the charge booked), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` ("posted" when the charge was booked).
